remarks: Welcome home to 3989 Staley Drive. This Exceptional Move-In Ready 4 Bedroom 2 Bath Colonial is located on a  quiet dead-end street, just one block outside the beautiful Village of Hamburg. All the convenience of living in the Village with no Village taxes. Let's start in the fully applianced kitchen with beautiful cherry cabinets and Corian countertops & walk in pantry. Nice size dining room off of the kitchen great for entertaining. Large living room with built-ins and a gorgeous gas fireplace with a granite & wood mantle to cozy up to. Family room with floor to ceiling bow windows. Full bath on first floor with first floor laundry hook-ups. Beautiful hardwood floors throughout. Master bedroom is oversized and has plenty of closet space. Three additional bedrooms one is lofted with vaulted ceilings. The Full-size Bathroom on the second floor is in perfect condition with tiled floor and new Vanity and lighted/ heated mirror. The stairs down to the basement lead to an oversized, completely finished and tiled basement room, with a newly installed egress wonderful room to enjoy the football games ahead. In the washer dryer laundry area, there's lots of space with a separate storage room. All of the plumbing, electronics, heating system, central air conditioning, and humidity system are well maintained annually and in perfect condition. Let's head outside to the enviable in-ground Gunite pool created by Beauty Pools with a large rock Waterfall that is in pristine condition, easy walk-in shallow end, plus a spacious wrap around cement poolside patio. The saltwater system, filter, and pool equipment are in excellent condition, including a brand-new oversized heater, which works great to extend the pool season. There is a very large fenced in backyard with beautifully maintained Oriental gardens which bloom all Spring and Summer. Two cement patios off the back of the house to enhance outdoor space, large gazebo with bar tops for seating that give beautiful views to the backyard and pool. No rear neighbor's house backs up to Hamburg athletic fields. Close to all Village Amenities and local expressways. Showings begin October 23 at 3 PM-Open house Saturday 10/24 11-1 pm
